title: Giving an account to synced records
summary: Give an account to the records a connected company sent, and review the accounts sync added.

steps.text: {title} lists the records a connected company sent that wait for an account, the accounts sync added here, and a new client's accounts to review. Choose an account for each, or {none} when all is in order.
You can also ask the assistant which records are waiting for an account.
